Description: Unique 6-character hex code identifying the product (e.g. A1B2C3)
Notes: Leave blank for new products. Fill only to update an existing product or preserve a specific ID on re-import.

Description: Name of the drug or product
Notes: Row is silently skipped if this is missing.
Drives the unit/pack price split in billing. Also used to distinguish two products with the same name.

Description: Harmonised System of Nomenclature code used for GST invoicing
Notes: Required if you need GST-compliant purchase invoices.

Description: Qty threshold below which the product is flagged as LOW STOCK
GST percentage defined at the product catalog level (e.g. 12.00)
Comma-separated generic names or search aliases for the product
Vendor batch number printed on the physical box
Notes: Without this re-importing later cannot match the batch in place and will create a duplicate.

Description: Expiry date of this specific batch in MM/YY format (e.g. 06/27)
Notes: Without this expiry alerts and FIFO stock deduction ordering will not work correctly.

Description: Maximum Retail Price per pack — what the patient is charged
Notes: Billing will show 0 if left blank. For ea (per-unit) billing this is divided by the pack multiplier.

Description: Cost price paid to the supplier per unit
Notes: Used for profit/margin tracking. Not shown to patients.

Description: GST percentage actually applied on this batch at time of purchase
Notes: May differ from Product GST Rate if the supplier invoice used a different rate.

Description: Total tax amount paid for the full batch quantity
Notes: Export-only field. The system does not read this back. You can leave it blank or delete the column entirely.

Description: Current stock available for this batch
Notes: In update mode rows with qty 0 or blank are skipped. In overwrite mode qty 0 creates no stock. For new products, this becomes the opening stock.

Description: Stock count at the time this batch was first received
Notes: Only differs from Quantity if some stock has already been consumed.

Description: Bonus/free units included in this batch (e.g. buy 100 get 10 free)
